title: Review of c02's FCH chemoton (SIBE): on fresh seed 5 the catalyst sits on one open strip, not a vesicle (K rim/core 0.54, 0/36 membrane-like), and a starvation fork shrinks every body to a micelle that is still alive 700 time units after the cut
summary: Fresh seed 5 (labkit, T=600, 192^2). From noise, micelles grow into strands, rings and tripods by t~50; the catalyst K survives on only one body, an open bilayer strip (t=81 onward), as on the claim's seed 1, while the other five bodies carry no K and shrink slowly on amphiphile shared through the bath (one ring persists). labkit: K rim/core 0.54, rim/outside 1.72, 0/36 individuals membrane-like; only u is ring-like on one track. E fork (my own, same seed, feed cut at t=300, and a long fork to t=999): total amphiphile falls 2309 -> 323 at t=600 (fed twin 1984) and 58 at t=999, but all 6 bodies are still present at t=999 as small micelles (starve_long/seed5/sheet.png); the K strip contracts to a dot that keeps its K. So the fork shows shrinkage to a minimal micelle, not death within 700 time units, and the fed twin also declines slowly (2309 -> 1984). S and I replicate; B and E do not on this seed.

observations.S: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0: noisy bath over the whole domain; micelles by t=24
observations.I: rerun/seed5/tracks.png: six discrete bodies (strands, a tripod, a ring) persisting t~90-600

seeds_run.result: S, I pass; K only on one open strip (no K layer on a vesicle); starved bodies shrink to micelles and persist to t=999

controls_run.E: starve/seed5 and starve_long/seed5 (precursor cut at t=300 against the fed twin rerun/seed5): 6 -> 6 bodies at t=600 and at t=999, amphiphile 2309 -> 323 -> 58

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. On it the claimed individual (a vesicle with K beaded on its bilayer) does not form: K survives only on an open strip, and the K-free bodies live on amphiphile exported through the bath, so the bodies that persist are not the ones that make their material. The E fork removes material but no individual dies within 700 time units (they become minimal micelles); E as material dependence holds by construction (amphiphile is made only by K from P and decays), but the rubric's 'individuals die' is not shown here. B may still hold on the claim's seeds 0 and 2.
